newsitem.title: USA: Smith's Food stake raised by Transamerica.
newsitem.headline: Smith's Food stake raised by Transamerica.

text.p: Transamerica Corp said Thursday it raised its stake in Smith's Food & Drug Centers Inc to 1,744,534 common shares or 16.42 percent from 14.68 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Transamerica said its latest transactions include the purchase of 45,100 common shares between August 8 and October 3 at prices ranging from $27.3266 to $28.25 per share.
Transamerica said its subsidiaries also hold 1,231,534 shares of Smith's Foods, including 1,184,201 shares on behalf of investment advisory clients.
The shares represent an additional 11.59 percent of the class B outstanding shares, the filing said.
